text:
Maya: Hi! Opening my first PR to change a header in runtime. Quick: branch name pattern? Must-pass CI jobs? Any small PR etiquette?

Ravi: Welcome Maya. Branches: `feat/<name>/<short>` or `fix/<name>/<short>`. Target `main`. Keep PRs small.

Ava: Local checklist: `pre-commit`, `make test`, and `mypy`. Lint/mypy/tests are blockers.

Ravi: CODEOWNERS suggests reviewers; add one explicit reviewer if unsure. Use Draft while iterating.

devex-bot: Reminder: add DCO footer and link a ticket (or `/no-ticket` + reason).

Maya: Great, thanks — I'll push `fix/maya/runtime-header` and post the PR in #devex when ready.

Ava: Also add a short repro snippet in the PR body if it's behavioral; saves time.

Maya: Will do, thanks!
